messages:
nora: heads-up: deploy-bot reports p95 spike on /completion in eu-central after 2.9.3. looks like tail latency only.
deploy-bot: deploybot:signal: region=eu-central route=/completion p95 > threshold for 5m. recommendation: STAGED_PIN previous-kernel. auto_revert: OFF.
ops-lead: agree with staged pin. plan 5% -> 20% -> 100% with 4m soak and smoke eval between steps.
ml-oncall: quick note: the new attention kernel increased mem pressure on long prompts; could cause sporadic tail.
nora: sample log: `2026-05-02T08:12:11Z route=/completion p95=510ms kernel=attn_fast`
support: I'll alert customers on the watchlist if we escalate to 100%.
ops-lead: executing 5% pin: `infractl pin --region eu-central --route /completion --version 2.9.2 --slice 5 --reason "p95 tail"`
deploy-bot: deploybot:action: pin_job started id=pin-1803456789-1
ops-lead: 5% stable after 4m, p95 improved ~40%. moving to 20%.
deploy-bot: deploybot:action: pin_job started id=pin-1803456789-2
ml-oncall: running smoke eval set "comp_tail_check" now — latency_ok=true quality_ok=true
ops-lead: ramping to 100% now.
deploy-bot: deploybot:action: pin_job started id=pin-1803456789-3
nora: posting brief: "Staged rollback to 2.9.2 in eu-central for /completion due to p95 tail. Monitoring and postmortem to follow."
support: ticket INF-2026-512 created for postmortem and release-note amendment.
deploy-bot: deploybot:signal: pin_job completed id=pin-1803456789-3 status=success
